headline: Aneesh & Yash gain 7.36 points and climb from 41st to 34th on ARC-2

sections.text: Aneesh & Yash gained 7.36 points to reach 53.33, moving from 41st to 34th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The public standings are provisional and medals are decided on the private board. The gold line stands at 66.53, so the team remains outside the medal places for now.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
